### Changed
- **atelet preempts lower-priority pods again: `substrate.atelet.priorityClass.preemptionPolicy: PreemptLowerPriority`** (giantswarm/agent-platform#993). Under `Never` (#731), an atelet whose node another pod filled while atelet was Pending stays Pending for good: no autoscaler adds a node for a DaemonSet pod, and that node places no actor. atelet moves back to the PriorityClass `ate-node-critical` (value `1000000000`, `PreemptLowerPriority`). On a node without room it evicts the lowest-priority pods first, the default-priority workloads before monitoring and the platform's own classes, and honours PodDisruptionBudgets where it can. An installation that must never be evicted from keeps `Never` in its own values. The upgrade rolls atelet once onto the class. `make verify-components` asserts the forwarded value.
